 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">ii </P>

<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>EMPLOYEE MATTERS AGREEMENT </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">This EMPLOYEE MATTERS AGREEMENT (this &#8220;<U>Agreement</U>&#8221;), dated as of October&nbsp;1, 2026, is entered into by and between
CORTEVA, INC., a Delaware corporation (&#8220;<U>RemainCo</U>&#8221;), and VYLOR INC., a Delaware corporation (&#8220;<U>SpinCo</U>&#8221;). Each of RemainCo and SpinCo is sometimes referred to herein as a &#8220;<U>Party</U>&#8221; and, together,
as the &#8220;<U>Parties</U>&#8221;. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>WHEREAS</B>, the Board of Directors of RemainCo (the &#8220;<U>RemainCo Board</U>&#8221;) has
determined that it is appropriate, desirable and in the best interests of RemainCo and its stockholders to separate RemainCo into two separate, publicly traded companies, one for each of (a)&nbsp;the SpinCo Business, which will be owned and
conducted, directly or indirectly, by SpinCo, and (b)&nbsp;the RemainCo Business, which will be owned and conducted, directly or indirectly, by RemainCo; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>WHEREAS</B>, in furtherance of the foregoing, RemainCo and SpinCo have entered into that certain Separation and Distribution Agreement,
dated as of September&nbsp;29, 2026 (the &#8220;<U>Separation Agreement</U>&#8221;); </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>WHEREAS</B>, in connection with the transactions
contemplated by the Separation Agreement, the Parties wish to enter into this Agreement in respect of certain employee matters. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>NOW,
THEREFORE</B>, in consideration of the foregoing and the mutual covenants and agreements contained herein, and intending to be legally bound hereby, the Parties hereby agree as follows: </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Capitalized terms used herein but not defined in <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;3.01</U> or elsewhere in this Agreement shall have the meaning
ascribed to such terms in the Separation Agreement. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:24pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>ARTICLE I </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>GENERAL PRINCIPLES </B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Except
as set forth otherwise in this Agreement, the following terms and conditions shall apply: </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Section<U></U>&nbsp;1.01. <U>Employees</U>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a) Prior to June&nbsp;1, 2026, RemainCo Ring-Fenced the SpinCo Employees and RemainCo Employees pursuant to an internal organization design
and talent selection process and as approved by RemainCo. Until the Effective Time, updates to the Ring-Fence shall only be made to reflect: (i)&nbsp;any SpinCo or RemainCo Employee who became a <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Non-Consenting</FONT>
Employee on or following the commencement of the Internal Reorganization; (ii)&nbsp;any new hires; (iii)&nbsp;any terminations (including terminations for cause, resignations, retirements or terminations due to death or disability);
(iv)&nbsp;employees returning from expatriate assignment; (v)&nbsp;corrections of good-faith errors or omissions by RemainCo; and (vi)&nbsp;any other change approved in writing by the Chief People Officer of RemainCo. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">1 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b) For a period of ninety (90)&nbsp;days following the Effective Time, if either of
RemainCo or SpinCo determines that a RemainCo or SpinCo Employee was selected for alignment to the wrong Party (a &#8220;<U>Ring-Fence Error</U>&#8221;), then the Chief People Officer of RemainCo or SpinCo, as applicable, shall notify the Chief
People Officer of the other Party of such Ring-Fence Error. Thereafter, the respective Chief People Officers shall cooperate in good faith to resolve the Ring-Fence Error, including by facilitating the transfer of employment of any improperly
Ring-Fenced employee to the employment of the appropriate Party. The Parties will share equally the cost of any severance Liabilities incurred in relation to the transfer of employment of an improperly Ring-Fenced employee. For all purposes under
this Agreement (including <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;1.04</U>), any employee transferred pursuant to this <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;1.01(b)</U> shall be treated as if such employee had been properly Ring-Fenced to the receiving Party and had
transferred to such Party at the Effective Time. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Section&nbsp;1.02. <U>Employment of Impacted Employees</U>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a) Except to the extent otherwise required by applicable Law, as otherwise provided in this Agreement or with respect to any <FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Non-Consenting</FONT> Employees or Delayed Employment Employees, prior to the Effective Time, the applicable Parties caused, or caused the applicable members of their Groups to cause: (i)&nbsp;RemainCo Employees to be
employed by (or continue to be employed by) RemainCo or a member of the RemainCo Group and to cease to be employed by SpinCo or a member of the SpinCo Group; and (ii)&nbsp;SpinCo Employees to be employed by (or continue to be employed by) SpinCo or
a member of the SpinCo Group and to cease to be employed by RemainCo or a member of the RemainCo Group. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b) To the extent any applicable
Law, Governmental Entity, Employee Representative Body or consultation obligation, administrative error, or immigration application prevented the Parties or the members of the applicable Groups from carrying out the transfers of employment set forth
in <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;1.02(a)</U> prior to the Effective Time, or otherwise as set forth on <U>Schedule 1.02(b)</U> to this Agreement, with respect to any Impacted Employee (each such employee, a &#8220;<U>Delayed Employment
Employee</U>&#8221;), the applicable Parties shall, or shall cause the members of the applicable Groups to, carry out the transfers of employment (including by offers of employment, employer substitution, entry into tripartite agreements or similar
methods of transfers of employment) under <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;1.02(a)</U> with respect to such employee on the earliest permissible date following the Effective Time (the &#8220;<U>Delayed Employment Date</U>&#8221;). The obligations under
this Agreement of the Party that will become the employer (directly or indirectly) of a Delayed Employment Employee shall not commence until the Delayed Employment Date. For the avoidance of doubt, such delay shall not constitute a breach of
obligations under <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;1.03</U>. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(c) Notwithstanding anything to the contrary in
<U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;1.02</U> or <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;1.03</U>, it shall not constitute a breach of this Agreement for RemainCo or the applicable member of the RemainCo Group, or SpinCo or the applicable member of the SpinCo Group,
that employs a Delayed Employment Employee as of immediately prior to the Effective Time to not effect the change of such Person&#8217;s employment pursuant to <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;1.02</U> until the Delayed Employment Date. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">2 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(d) Except to the extent otherwise required by applicable Law or a Labor Agreement,
immediately after the Effective Time, SpinCo or RemainCo, as applicable, shall, or shall cause the applicable member of its respective Group to, continue to employ any SpinCo Employee or RemainCo Employee, as applicable, who is an STD Employee and
will provide such employee with a leave of absence and an amount equivalent to the disability or income replacement benefits such employee received immediately before the Effective Time; <U>provided</U>, <U>however</U>, that to the extent such
individual, as of the Effective Time, is receiving or is entitled to receive short-term disability benefits, and subsequent to the Effective Time and before returning to active employment with SpinCo or RemainCo, as applicable, or a member of its
respective Group, becomes eligible to receive long-term disability benefits under a Benefit Plan sponsored by the other Party (and is not eligible to receive such long-term disability benefits under a Benefit Plan sponsored by such
individual&#8217;s employing entity), then, except as set forth on <U>Schedule 1.02(d)</U> to this Agreement, (i)&nbsp;such STD Employee shall be transferred to a member of the other Party&#8217;s Group and (ii)&nbsp;the other Party shall permit
such individual to continue to receive long-term disability benefits under the applicable Benefit Plan until such individual is no longer disabled or is no longer eligible for such benefits (each such individual, an &#8220;<U>LTD
Employee</U>&#8221;). If any such LTD Employee returns to active employment within twelve (12)&nbsp;months following the Effective Time, or such longer period if required by applicable Law, SpinCo or RemainCo, as applicable, shall offer employment
to such individual who is a SpinCo Employee or RemainCo Employee, as applicable, on the terms and conditions set forth herein. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Section<U></U>&nbsp;1.03. <U>SpinCo Benefit Plans and </U><U>RemainCo</U><U> Benefit Plans as of the Effective Time.</U> </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a) Except to the extent otherwise required by applicable Law, applicable Labor Agreement or as otherwise provided in this Agreement,
including as set forth on <U>Schedule 1.03(a)</U> to this Agreement and <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;1.02(d)</U>: </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(i) (x)
RemainCo shall, or shall have caused the applicable member of the RemainCo Group to, take all actions required to cause, as of no later than the Effective Time, each SpinCo Employee to cease to be an active participant in any Benefit Plan that will
not be a SpinCo Benefit Plan as of the Effective Time; and (y)&nbsp;SpinCo shall, or shall have caused the applicable member of the SpinCo Group to, take all actions required to cause, each SpinCo Employee who is employed by SpinCo or a member of
the SpinCo Group to commence participation, as of no later than the Effective Time, in all SpinCo Benefit Plans for which he or she is eligible; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(ii) SpinCo shall, or shall have caused the applicable member of the SpinCo Group to, take all actions required to cause, as of
no later than the Effective Time, each RemainCo Employee to cease to be an active participant in any Benefit Plan that will not be a RemainCo Benefit Plan as of the Effective Time; and </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">3 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(iii) for the avoidance of doubt, with respect to any Delayed Employment
Employees, the obligations under this Agreement of any Party (or its applicable Affiliate) by which such Delayed Employment Employee will ultimately be employed shall commence upon the Delayed Employment Date. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b) Effective as of no later than the Effective Time, SpinCo shall, and shall have caused the members of the SpinCo Group to, and where
applicable shall have used best efforts to cause other Persons to: (i)&nbsp;waive any limitations as to preexisting conditions, evidence of insurability, exclusions and waiting periods with respect to participation and coverage requirements for each
Impacted Employee under his or her respective plans and (ii)&nbsp;credit such Impacted Employee, for the plan year in which the Effective Time occurs, with the amount of any coinsurance, deductibles and <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap"><FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">out-of-pocket</FONT></FONT> maximums he or she paid prior to the applicable Effective Time during the plan year in which the Effective Time occurs. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Section<U></U>&nbsp;1.04. <U>Length of Service Crediting</U><I>.</I> Except to the extent otherwise required by applicable Law, applicable
Labor Agreement or as otherwise provided in this Agreement, effective as of no later than the Effective Time, SpinCo shall, or shall have caused the applicable member of the SpinCo Group to, recognize all service of any SpinCo Employee with RemainCo
or any of its Affiliates and with any predecessor employer (to the extent such predecessor employer service was taken into account under the applicable Benefit Plan) for all purposes (including, for purposes of vesting, eligibility to participate
and receive benefits, benefit forms, premium subsidies or credits, early retirement and waiver of any reduction factors, and benefit calculations and accruals) under any SpinCo Benefit Plans, or SpinCo Future Benefit Plans in which such SpinCo
Employee is, or becomes, eligible to participate on, or after, the Effective Time (<U>provided</U> that vacation attributable to imputed or <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">pre-employment</FONT> service may be credited as other paid time off);
<U>provided</U>, <U>however</U>, that, notwithstanding the foregoing, SpinCo and each member of the SpinCo Group shall not be required to recognize such service for purposes of benefit accruals under any SpinCo Benefit Plans or SpinCo Future Benefit
Plans that (i)&nbsp;are defined benefit pension plans, (ii)&nbsp;are other post-employment benefit plans (for the avoidance of doubt, exclusive of Severance) or (iii)&nbsp;would result in the duplication of any benefits thereunder or the funding
thereof. In the event that any employee of a member of the RemainCo Group or SpinCo Group is subsequently rehired by a member of the other Party&#8217;s Group within twelve (12)&nbsp;months following the Effective Time, such rehiring Party shall
recognize such employee&#8217;s prior service with the other Party&#8217;s Group for all purposes described in this <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;1.04</U> (with the exception of severance or any other end of service retirement/termination indemnity
benefit for which the rehire date will be used), subject to the limitations set forth herein. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Section<U></U>&nbsp;1.05. <U>Vacation</U>.
Except to the extent otherwise required by applicable Law or applicable Labor Agreement, and notwithstanding anything to the contrary in this Agreement, as of no later than the Effective Time, each of RemainCo and SpinCo shall have been Allocated,
or caused the applicable member of its respective Group to be Allocated, all Liabilities for earned but unused vacation benefits of the RemainCo Employees or SpinCo Employees, respectively (the &#8220;<U>Allocated Vacation Liabilities</U>&#8221;),
and all members of the RemainCo Group or SpinCo Group, as applicable, were relieved of, and </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">4 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">
shall have no Liabilities with respect to, such Allocated Vacation Liabilities of the other Party&#8217;s Group as of the date of such Assumption. To the extent that any earned but unused
vacation benefits are required to be paid in cash at the Effective Time by applicable Law or applicable Labor Agreement and cannot be Allocated between RemainCo or SpinCo pursuant to the prior sentence, RemainCo or SpinCo, as applicable, shall be
solely responsible for any cash payments required to be made to a RemainCo Employee or SpinCo Employee, as applicable, in respect of earned but unused vacation benefits (the &#8220;<U>Vacation Payout Liabilities</U>&#8221;). If either Party is
unable to make cash payments to their respective employees in respect of the Vacation Payout Liabilities and the other Party is required to discharge such Vacation Payout Liabilities, the other Party, or the applicable member of the Party&#8217;s
Group, shall reimburse and indemnify the other Party or the applicable member of the other Party&#8217;s Group for all such Vacation Payout Liabilities. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Section<U></U>&nbsp;1.06. <U>Severance</U>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a) <I>Severance for Terminations on or Prior to Effective Time</I>. Except to the extent otherwise required by applicable Law, applicable
Labor Agreement or as otherwise provided in this Agreement, if Severance was paid or became payable to any individual on or before the Effective Time, the applicable entity that was the employing legal entity of such individual shall remain
responsible for any remaining payment of such Severance pursuant to the applicable Benefit Plan and otherwise pursuant to the applicable Labor Agreement or applicable Law. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b) <I>Severance for Terminations Following the Effective Time</I>. Except to the extent otherwise required by applicable Law, applicable
Labor Agreement or as otherwise provided in this Agreement, if RemainCo or any member of the RemainCo Group, or SpinCo or any member of the SpinCo Group, as applicable, terminates the employment of any RemainCo Employee or SpinCo Employee,
respectively, within twelve (12)&nbsp;months following the Effective Time for any reason that entitles such employee to cash Severance under the applicable RemainCo Severance Plan or SpinCo Severance Plan, as applicable, RemainCo or SpinCo, as
applicable, shall pay to such employee at least the amount of cash Severance such employee would have received under the applicable Benefit Plan, as in effect immediately prior to the Effective Time. The calculation of cash Severance shall factor in
his or her additional length of service and changes in his or her eligible pay between the Effective Time and the date of his or her termination, but without regard to any period of service before the Effective Time that was taken into account in
determining the amount of cash Severance actually previously paid or provided by any Party before the Effective Time. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Section<U></U>&nbsp;1.07. <U>Annual Cash Incentives</U>. Annual cash incentive compensation earned or accrued by or in respect of any RemainCo
Employee or SpinCo Employee for the fiscal year in which the Effective Time occurs shall be paid by a member of the applicable Group, in the year following the year in which the Effective Time occurs, pursuant to the terms and conditions of the
applicable Group annual cash incentive plan or policy in place at the Effective Time. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">5 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Section<U></U>&nbsp;1.08. <U>Equity Awards.</U> </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a) <I>Conversion of Certain Performance Stock Units</I>. Prior to the Effective Time, each Performance Stock Unit granted prior to 2026 will
have been adjusted and converted into a Restricted Stock Unit, as determined by the RemainCo Board or a committee thereof, based on attainment of the actual level of performance immediately prior to the Effective Time (each such award, a
&#8220;<U>Converted PSU</U>&#8221;). </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b) <I>Conversion of Shareholder Method Awards</I>. Each Shareholder Method Award that is
outstanding as of immediately prior to the Distribution shall be converted, effective as of the Effective Time, into a SpinCo Equity Award and a RemainCo Equity Award, so that, immediately following such conversion, (i)&nbsp;the number of shares of
SpinCo Common Stock subject to such SpinCo Equity Award (an &#8220;<U>Adjusted SpinCo Shareholder Method Award</U>&#8221;) shall be equal to the number of shares of SpinCo Common Stock that would have been received in the Distribution had the
RemainCo Common Stock underlying the Shareholder Method Award been issued and outstanding immediately prior to the Distribution, and (ii)&nbsp;the number of shares of RemainCo Common Stock subject to such RemainCo Equity Award (an &#8220;<U>Adjusted
RemainCo Shareholder Method Award</U>&#8221;) shall be equal to the number of shares of RemainCo Common Stock subject to the Shareholder Method Award immediately prior to the Distribution, in each case, with such resulting number of shares rounded
up to the nearest number of whole shares (but with shares in respect of dividend equivalent units rounded to four decimal places). </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(c)
<I>Conversion of Employer Method Awards held by SpinCo Employees.</I><I><SUP STYLE="font-size:75%; vertical-align:top"> </SUP></I> </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(i) <I>2026 RSU Awards held by SpinCo Employees</I>. Each 2026 RSU Award that is outstanding as of immediately prior to the
Distribution and that is held by a SpinCo Employee shall be converted, as of the Effective Time, into a time-based restricted stock unit (an &#8220;<U>Adjusted SpinCo RSU</U>&#8221;) with respect to a number of shares of SpinCo Common Stock equal to
(x)&nbsp;the number of shares of RemainCo Common Stock subject to such 2026 RSU Award, <I>multiplied by </I>(y)&nbsp;the SpinCo Conversion Ratio, with such resulting number of shares of SpinCo Common Stock rounded up to the nearest number of whole
shares (but with shares in respect of dividend equivalent units rounded to four decimal places). </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(ii) <I>Stock Options
held by SpinCo Employees</I>. Each Stock Option, whether vested or unvested, that is outstanding as of immediately prior to the Distribution and that is held by a SpinCo Employee shall be converted, as of the Effective Time, into an option (an
&#8220;<U>Adjusted SpinCo Option</U>&#8221;), with respect to a number of shares of SpinCo Common Stock, rounded down to the nearest number of whole shares, equal to the product of the number of shares subject to such Stock Option <I>multiplied
by</I> the SpinCo Conversion Ratio, and with a <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">per-share</FONT> exercise price, rounded up to the nearest whole cent, equal to such Stock Option&#8217;s per share exercise price <I>divided by</I> the SpinCo
Conversion Ratio. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">6 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(iii) <I>2026 PSU Awards held by SpinCo Employees</I>. Each 2026 PSU Award
that is outstanding as of immediately prior to the Distribution and that is held by a SpinCo Employee shall be converted, as of the Effective Time, into a performance-based restricted stock unit (an &#8220;<U>Adjusted SpinCo PSU</U>&#8221;) with
respect to a number of shares of SpinCo Common Stock (at target) equal to (x)&nbsp;the target number of shares of RemainCo Common Stock subject to such 2026 PSU Award, <I>multiplied by </I>(y)&nbsp;the SpinCo Conversion Ratio, with such resulting
number of shares of SpinCo Common Stock rounded up to the nearest number of whole shares (but with shares in respect of dividend equivalent units rounded to four decimal places). Each such Adjusted SpinCo PSU shall have substantially the same terms
and conditions (including vesting schedule) as the corresponding 2026 PSU Award to which it relates; <U>provided</U> that the performance conditions applicable to each Adjusted SpinCo PSU shall be adjusted by the Board of Directors of SpinCo or a
committee thereof following the Distribution. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(d) <I>Conversion of Other Employer Method Awards</I>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(i) <I>Restricted Stock Units</I>. Each (x) 2026 RSU Award that is outstanding as of immediately prior to the Distribution and
that is not converted pursuant to <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;1.08(c)(i)</U>, (y) Restricted Stock Unit granted during 2024 or 2025 that is outstanding as of immediately prior to the Distribution and that is held by a Former Employee and
(z)&nbsp;Converted PSU that is outstanding as of immediately prior to the Distribution and that is held by a Former Employee shall be converted, as of the Effective Time, into a time-based restricted stock unit (an &#8220;<U>Adjusted RemainCo
RSU</U>&#8221;) with respect to a number of shares of RemainCo Common Stock equal to (x)&nbsp;the number of shares of RemainCo Common Stock subject to such award, <I>multiplied by </I>(y)&nbsp;the RemainCo Conversion Ratio, with such resulting
number of shares of RemainCo Common Stock rounded up to the nearest number of whole shares (but with shares in respect of dividend equivalent units rounded to four decimal places). </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(ii) <I>Stock Options</I>. Each Stock Option that is outstanding as of immediately prior to the Distribution and that is not
converted pursuant to <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;1.08(c)(ii)</U> shall be converted, as of the Effective Time, into an option (an &#8220;<U>Adjusted RemainCo Option</U>&#8221;), in respect of a number of shares of RemainCo Common Stock, rounded
down to the nearest number of whole shares, equal to the product of the number of shares subject to such Stock Option <I>multiplied by</I> the RemainCo Conversion Ratio, and with a <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">per-share</FONT> exercise price,
rounded up to the nearest whole cent, equal to such Stock Option&#8217;s per share exercise price <I>divided by</I> the RemainCo Conversion Ratio. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(iii) <I>2026 PSU Awards</I>. Each 2026 PSU Award that is outstanding as of immediately prior to the Distribution and that is
not converted pursuant to <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;1.08(c)(iii)</U> shall be converted, as of the Effective Time, into a performance-based restricted stock unit (an &#8220;<U>Adjusted RemainCo PSU</U>&#8221;) with respect to a number of shares
of RemainCo Common Stock (at target) equal to (x)&nbsp;the target number of shares of RemainCo Common Stock subject to such 2026 PSU Award, <I>multiplied by </I>(y)&nbsp;the RemainCo Conversion Ratio, with such resulting number of shares of RemainCo
Common Stock rounded up to the nearest number of whole shares (but with shares in respect of dividend equivalent units rounded to four decimal places). Each such Adjusted RemainCo PSU shall have substantially the same terms and conditions (including
vesting schedule) as the corresponding 2026 PSU Award to which it relates; <U>provided</U> that the performance conditions applicable to each Adjusted RemainCo PSU shall be adjusted by the RemainCo Board or a committee thereof following the
Distribution. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">7 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(e) <I>RemainCo Equity Awards held by Former Employees</I>. Notwithstanding anything to the
contrary in this Agreement, RemainCo shall be Allocated all Liabilities with respect to any RemainCo Equity Award held by a Former Employee that is outstanding as of immediately prior to the Distribution. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(f) <I>Award Terms; Vesting; Treatment of Service</I>. Except as otherwise provided in this <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;1.08</U>, the terms
and conditions applicable to the Adjusted SpinCo Shareholder Method Awards, Adjusted RemainCo Shareholder Method Awards, Adjusted SpinCo RSUs, Adjusted SpinCo Options, Adjusted SpinCo PSUs, Adjusted RemainCo RSUs, Adjusted RemainCo Options and
Adjusted RemainCo PSUs shall be substantially identical to the terms and conditions applicable to the applicable underlying RemainCo Equity Award (as set forth in the applicable plan, award agreement or in any otherwise applicable agreement with
RemainCo or its Affiliates). All SpinCo Equity Awards shall become vested upon the date the underlying RemainCo Equity Award would have otherwise vested in accordance with the existing terms and vesting schedule. For the avoidance of doubt, each
Converted PSU that becomes a SpinCo Equity Award shall be subject to solely service-based vesting conditions but shall otherwise remain subject to the same terms, conditions and vesting schedule as applied to such RemainCo Equity Award prior to the
Distribution. For purposes of determining continued vesting in SpinCo Equity Awards and RemainCo Equity Awards, as applicable, each Party shall take into account all employment and service with both SpinCo and RemainCo, and their respective
Subsidiaries and Affiliates, for purposes of determining when such SpinCo Equity Awards or RemainCo Equity Awards, as applicable, vest or terminate. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(g) <I>Certain Additional Considerations</I>. Notwithstanding anything to the contrary in this <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;1.08</U>: </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(i) To the extent the RemainCo Board determines before the Effective Time that the treatment of an award as a Shareholder
Method Award is not practicable due to applicable Laws or the potential imposition of adverse Taxes or penalties, such awards shall be treated as Employer Method Awards. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(ii) The Parties shall cooperate in good faith, in respect of jurisdictions outside the United States, to treat Shareholder
Method Awards as Employer Method Awards where Tax or regulatory considerations render the treatment of Shareholder Method Awards unduly burdensome to the holder thereof. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(iii) All of the adjustments described in this <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;1.08</U> shall be effected in accordance with
Sections 409A and 424 of the Code. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">8 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(iv) The Parties hereby acknowledge that the provisions of this
<U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;1.08</U> are intended to achieve certain Tax, legal and accounting objectives and, in the event such objectives are not achieved, the Parties agree to negotiate in good faith regarding such other actions that may be
necessary or appropriate to achieve such objectives. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(h) <I>Employee Stock Purchase Plan.</I> </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(i) <I>RemainCo ESPP</I>. As of the Effective Time, the SpinCo Employees shall cease to be Eligible Employees (as defined in
the RemainCo ESPP), in each case, in accordance with the terms of the RemainCo ESPP. In accordance with the terms of the RemainCo ESPP, on account of ceasing to be Eligible Employees thereunder, as of the Effective Time, the SpinCo Employees shall
(i)&nbsp;cease to be eligible to contribute to the RemainCo ESPP and (ii)&nbsp;be entitled to receive a refund of their payroll deductions in accordance with the terms of the RemainCo ESPP. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(ii) <I>SpinCo ESPP</I>. As of no later than the Effective Time, SpinCo shall adopt an employee stock purchase plan within the
meaning of Section&nbsp;423 of the Code (the &#8220;<U>SpinCo ESPP</U>&#8221;). The terms and conditions of the SpinCo ESPP, including eligibility requirements, participating jurisdictions, and commencement dates, shall be determined by SpinCo in
its sole discretion and may vary by country, jurisdiction, or employee population as necessary to comply with applicable Law, regulatory requirements, tax considerations, and administrative feasibility. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(i) <I>Equity Plan Adoption; Registration Statement</I>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(i) Effective as of the Effective Time, SpinCo shall have adopted an equity incentive plan (the &#8220;<U>SpinCo Stock
Plan</U>&#8221;), which permits the issuance of SpinCo Equity Awards as described in this <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;1.08</U>. The SpinCo Stock Plan shall be approved before the Effective Time by EIDP, Inc. as SpinCo&#8217;s sole stockholder.
</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(ii) SpinCo shall use commercially reasonable efforts to maintain effective registration statements with the Securities
and Exchange Commission with respect to the SpinCo Equity Awards and the SpinCo ESPP described in this <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;1.08</U>, to the extent any such registration statement is required by applicable Law. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(j) <I>Settlement, Delivery; Tax Reporting and Withholding</I>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(i) From and after the applicable Effective Time, (x)&nbsp;SpinCo shall have sole responsibility for the settlement of and/or
delivery of shares of SpinCo Common Stock pursuant to SpinCo Equity Awards to any holder of such award and shall be solely entitled to any exercise price payable in respect of SpinCo Options, and except as otherwise provided in this
<U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;1.08(j)</U>, SpinCo shall do so without compensation from RemainCo, and (y)&nbsp;RemainCo shall have sole responsibility for the settlement of and/or delivery of shares of RemainCo Common Stock pursuant to RemainCo
Equity Awards that remain denominated in RemainCo Common Stock to any holder of such award and shall be solely entitled to any exercise price payable in respect of RemainCo Options, and except as otherwise provided in this
<U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;1.08(j)</U>, RemainCo shall do so without compensation from SpinCo. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">9 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(ii) Upon the vesting, payment or settlement, as applicable, of SpinCo
Equity Awards (in each case including with respect to dividends and dividend equivalents), SpinCo shall be solely entitled to a Tax deduction in respect of, and shall be solely responsible for ensuring the satisfaction of all applicable Tax
withholding requirements on behalf of, each holder thereof who is or, upon their last employment termination, was employed by a member of the SpinCo Group (or who holds the award in respect of any such individual), and for ensuring the collection
and remittance of applicable employee withholding Taxes to the applicable Governmental Entity. To the extent shares of SpinCo Common Stock are withheld and/or delivered to satisfy Tax withholding obligations in respect of the vesting, payment or
settlement of SpinCo Equity Awards, to the extent the issuer is not responsible pursuant to this <U>clause (ii)</U>&nbsp;for satisfying the applicable Tax withholding and remittance requirements, the issuer shall remit to the responsible Party cash
in an amount sufficient to satisfy such requirements. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(iii) The Parties shall establish an appropriate administration
system in order to handle in an orderly manner exercises of SpinCo Options and the settlement of other SpinCo Equity Awards and RemainCo Equity Awards, and to effect the Tax benefits and obligations contemplated by this
<U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;1.08</U>. Each of the Parties shall provide the other with such records and information as reasonably necessary or appropriate (including payroll and employment information on regular timetables) and make certain that
each applicable entity&#8217;s data and records in respect of such awards are correct and updated on a timely basis. Each Party shall be responsible for the accuracy of records and information provided to the other Party pursuant to this
<U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;1.08</U> and shall indemnify such other Party for any losses caused by inaccurate information that it has provided (including failure to timely provide such records and information). The foregoing shall include
employment status and information required for Tax withholding/remittance, compliance with trading windows and compliance with the requirements of applicable Laws. In the event of a subsequent acquisition, divestiture, spinoff or other corporate
transaction involving either Party, such Party shall use best efforts to ensure comparable cooperation from such Party&#8217;s successor. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><U>(k)</U> <I>Definitions</I>. For purposes of this <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;1.08</U>: </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(i) &#8220;<U>2026 PSU Award</U>&#8221; means each Performance Stock Unit granted during 2026. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(ii) &#8220;<U>2026 RSU Award</U>&#8221; means each Restricted Stock Unit granted during 2026. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">10 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(iii) &#8220;<U>Employer Method Award</U>&#8221; means each RemainCo Equity
Award as of immediately prior to the Effective Time that is (i)&nbsp;a Stock Option, (ii)&nbsp;a 2026 PSU Award, (iii)&nbsp;a 2026 RSU Award, (iv)&nbsp;a Restricted Stock Unit granted during 2024 or 2025 held by a Former Employee or (v)&nbsp;a
Converted PSU held by a Former Employee. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(iv) &#8220;<U>Performance Stock Unit</U>&#8221; means a RemainCo Equity Award
that is a performance-based restricted stock unit award. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(v) &#8220;<U>Post-Spin RemainCo Share Price</U>&#8221; means the
<FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">one-day</FONT> volume weighted average price of RemainCo Common Stock on the New York Stock Exchange, on the trading date immediately following the Effective Time (or, if none, on the first trading day thereafter).
</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(vi) &#8220;<U>Post-Spin SpinCo Share Price</U>&#8221; means the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">one-day</FONT> volume
weighted average price of SpinCo Common Stock on the New York Stock Exchange, on the trading date immediately following the Effective Time (or, if none, on the first trading day thereafter). </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(vii) &#8220;<U><FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Pre-Spin</FONT> Share Price</U>&#8221; means the closing <FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">per-share</FONT> price of RemainCo Common Stock, trading on a &#8220;regular way with due bills&#8221; basis, on the New York Stock Exchange on the day immediately prior to the Effective Time (or, if none, on the first
trading day prior thereto). </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(viii) &#8220;<U>RemainCo Conversion Ratio</U>&#8221; means a fraction, the numerator of which
is the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Pre-Spin</FONT> Share Price, and the denominator of which is the Post-Spin RemainCo Share Price. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(ix) &#8220;<U>RemainCo Equity Award</U>&#8221; means (i)&nbsp;prior to the Effective Time, each Performance Stock Unit,
Restricted Stock Unit or Stock Option outstanding immediately prior to the Effective Time and originally granted under the RemainCo Equity Plan and (ii)&nbsp;following the Effective Time, each Performance Stock Unit, Restricted Stock Unit or Stock
Option that, after the application of <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;1.08</U>, remains denominated in RemainCo Common Stock. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(x) &#8220;<U>RemainCo ESPP</U>&#8221; means the Corteva, Inc. Global Omnibus Employee Stock Purchase Plan (as may be amended
from time to time). </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(xi) &#8220;<U>RemainCo Option</U>&#8221; means each RemainCo Equity Award that is a Stock Option.
</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(xii) &#8220;<U>Restricted Stock Unit</U>&#8221; means a RemainCo Equity Award that is a time-based restricted stock unit
award. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(xiii) &#8220;<U>Shareholder Method Award</U>&#8221; means each RemainCo Equity Award that, as of immediately prior
to the Effective Time, is (i)&nbsp;held by a <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-employee</FONT> member of the RemainCo Board or a Former Director, (ii)&nbsp;a Restricted Stock Unit granted during 2024 or 2025 (other than those held by a Former
Employee) or (iii)&nbsp;a Converted PSU (other than those held by a Former Employee). </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">11 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(xiv) &#8220;<U>SpinCo Conversion Ratio</U>&#8221; means a fraction, the
numerator of which is the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Pre-Spin</FONT> Share Price, and the denominator of which is the Post-Spin SpinCo Share Price. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(xv) &#8220;<U>SpinCo Equity Award</U>&#8221; means a RemainCo Equity Award that, after application of this
<U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;1.08</U>, is denominated in SpinCo Common Stock. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(xvi) &#8220;<U>SpinCo Option</U>&#8221;
means each SpinCo Equity Award that is a Stock Option. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(xvii) &#8220;<U>Stock Option</U>&#8221; means a RemainCo Equity
Award that is an option to acquire common stock. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Section<U></U>&nbsp;1.09. <U>Pension/OPEB/Welfare Benefit Claims</U>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a) <I><FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Non-U.S.</FONT> Defined Benefit Pension Plans or Defined Contribution Plans</I>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(i) Except to the extent required by applicable Law or as otherwise provided in <U>subsection (a)(ii)</U> below, there shall be
no Transfer of Assets or Liabilities (including, without limitation, with respect to Actions) between, or otherwise among the Parties in respect of, any Benefit Plan maintained by any of them or their respective Affiliates that is a <FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-U.S.</FONT> defined benefit pension plan or defined contribution plan. For the avoidance of doubt, <U>Schedule 1.09(a)(i)</U> to this Agreement identifies those arrangements where there shall be a Transfer of Assets or
Liabilities or both as required by applicable Law, and any arrangement not identified on such <U>Schedule 1.09(a)(i)</U> shall be deemed for purposes of this Agreement to be one for which such a Transfer of Assets or Liabilities is not required by
applicable Law. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(ii) To the extent provided in <U>Schedule 1.09(a)(ii)</U> to this Agreement, the Parties shall cause the
Transfer of Assets or Liabilities between, or otherwise among them in respect of, any Benefit Plan maintained by any of them or their respective Affiliates that are <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-U.S.</FONT> defined benefit pension plans or
defined contribution plans, notwithstanding that such Transfer of Assets or Liabilities is not otherwise required by applicable Law. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b)
<I>Other Post-Employment Benefits</I>. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(i) Except to the extent required by applicable Law or as otherwise provided in
<U>subsection (b)(ii)</U> below, there shall be no Transfer of Assets or Liabilities (including, without limitation, with respect to Actions) between, or otherwise among the Parties in respect of, any OPEB Plan. For the avoidance of doubt,
<U>Schedule 1.09(b)(i)</U> to this Agreement identifies those OPEB Plans where there shall be a Transfer of Assets or Liabilities or both as required by applicable Law. Any OPEB Plan not identified on such <U>Schedule 1.09(b)(i)</U> shall be deemed
for purposes of this Agreement to be one for which such a Transfer of Assets or Liabilities is not required by applicable Law. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">12 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(ii) The Benefit Plans identified on <U>Schedule 1.09(b)(ii)</U> to this
Agreement shall be Allocated as indicated therein. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(c) <I>Welfare Benefit Claims</I>. Except as explicitly provided in this Agreement,
the sponsoring entity of each Benefit Plan that is a welfare benefits plan shall remain responsible for any claims under any such Benefit Plan that were incurred prior to the Effective Time; <U>provided</U>, <U>however</U>, <U>that</U>, with respect
to any such claims within the United States, RemainCo shall remain responsible for such claims. Except in the event of any claim for workers&#8217; compensation benefits for purposes of <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;2.05</U>, any claims shall be
deemed to be incurred pursuant to the terms and conditions of the Benefit Plans that are welfare benefits plans; <U>provided</U> that the Parties shall use their best efforts to ensure that there is no failure to cover any claim that otherwise would
have been covered under any Benefit Plans that are welfare benefits plans but for the provisions of this Agreement. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Section<U></U>&nbsp;1.10. <U>Labor Matters</U>. As of no later than the Effective Time, (i)&nbsp;RemainCo, or the applicable members of the
RemainCo Group, shall have been Allocated, in accordance with its terms, each of the RemainCo Labor Agreements covering RemainCo Employees immediately prior to the commencement of the Internal Reorganization; <U>provided</U>, <U>however</U>, that,
with respect to any such RemainCo Labor Agreement that also covers SpinCo Employees, (1)&nbsp;RemainCo or the applicable member of the RemainCo Group shall have been Allocated such RemainCo Labor Agreement only with respect to the RemainCo
Employees, and (2)&nbsp;SpinCo or a member of the SpinCo Group, as applicable, shall have been Allocated such RemainCo Labor Agreement only with respect to the SpinCo Employees, as applicable; and (ii)&nbsp;SpinCo or the applicable members of the
SpinCo Group shall have been Allocated, in accordance with its terms, each of the SpinCo Labor Agreements covering SpinCo Employees immediately prior to the commencement of the Internal Reorganization; <U>provided</U>, <U>however</U>, that, with
respect to any such SpinCo Labor Agreement that also covers RemainCo Employees, SpinCo or the applicable member of the SpinCo Group shall have been Allocated such SpinCo Labor Agreement only with respect to SpinCo Employees and RemainCo, or a member
of the RemainCo Group, as applicable, shall have been Allocated such SpinCo Labor Agreement only with respect to RemainCo Employees, as applicable. Notwithstanding anything to the contrary in this Agreement, as of the Effective Time, except as
agreed with the applicable union or labor organization: (i)&nbsp;RemainCo shall continue to honor, or cause the applicable members of the RemainCo Group to continue to honor, in accordance with their terms, each of the RemainCo Labor Agreements; and
(ii)&nbsp;SpinCo shall continue to honor, or cause the applicable members of the SpinCo Group to continue to honor, in accordance with their terms, each of the SpinCo Labor Agreements. As of no later than the Effective Time, each Party complied, or
caused the applicable member of its Group to comply, with any obligations it had under applicable Laws and applicable Labor Agreements to inform and/or consult with any Employee Representative Body or group of employees in connection with this
Agreement, the arrangements proposed in this Agreement, the Internal Reorganization and/or the Distribution. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">13 </P>

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Section<U></U>&nbsp;1.11. <U>Expatriate Assignments</U>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a) <I>Allocation of Liabilities for Concluded Expatriate Assignments</I>. Except to the extent otherwise required by applicable Law, and
notwithstanding anything to the contrary in <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;1.14</U>: (i) RemainCo shall, or shall cause the applicable member of the RemainCo Group to, be Allocated (1)&nbsp;all Liabilities (including obligations, if any, to
administer, or provide post-repatriation benefits or services under, RemainCo&#8217;s expatriate programs) arising from or relating to each RemainCo Employee whose expatriate assignment ended as of no later than the Effective Time (without regard to
which Party or Group member initiated such expatriate assignment), and (2)&nbsp;all rights to receive any repayment or reimbursement (including repayment or reimbursement of any trailing tax reconciliation or tax equalization by the applicable
RemainCo Employee) from such RemainCo Employee; and (ii)&nbsp;SpinCo shall, or shall cause the applicable member of the SpinCo Group to, be Allocated (1)&nbsp;all Liabilities (including obligations, if any, to administer, or provide
post-repatriation benefits or services under, RemainCo&#8217;s expatriate programs) arising from or relating to each SpinCo Employee whose expatriate assignment ended as of no later than the Effective Time (without regard to which Party or Group
member initiated such expatriate assignment), and (2)&nbsp;all rights to receive any repayment or reimbursement (including repayment or reimbursement of any trailing tax reconciliation or tax equalization by the applicable SpinCo Employee) from such
SpinCo Employee. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b) <I>Allocation of Liabilities for Ongoing Expatriate Assignments</I>. Except to the extent otherwise required by
applicable Law, and notwithstanding anything to the contrary in <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;1.14</U>: (i) RemainCo shall, or shall cause the applicable member of the RemainCo Group to, be Allocated all (1)&nbsp;Liabilities (including obligations,
if any, to provide post-repatriation benefits or services under RemainCo&#8217;s expatriate programs; <U>provided</U> that, except as otherwise required by applicable Law or applicable Labor Agreement, there shall be no obligation to continue such
benefits or services) arising from or relating to each RemainCo Employee whose expatriate assignment began prior to the Effective Time and which expatriate assignment is still in progress at the Effective Time (without regard to which Party or Group
member initiated such expatriate assignment); and (2)&nbsp;rights to receive any repayment or reimbursement (including repayment or reimbursement of any trailing tax reconciliation or tax equalization by the applicable RemainCo Employee) from such
RemainCo Employee; and (ii)&nbsp;SpinCo shall, or shall cause the applicable member of the SpinCo Group to, be Allocated all (1)&nbsp;Liabilities (including obligations, if any, to provide post-repatriation benefits or services under
RemainCo&#8217;s expatriate programs, as applicable; <U>provided</U> that, except as otherwise required by applicable Law or applicable Labor Agreement, there shall be no obligation to continue such benefits or services) arising from or relating to
each SpinCo Employee whose expatriate assignment began prior to the Effective Time, and which expatriate assignment is still in progress at the Effective Time (without regard to which Party or Group member initiated such expatriate assignment); and
(2)&nbsp;rights to receive any repayment or reimbursement (including repayment or reimbursement of any trailing tax reconciliation or tax equalization by the applicable SpinCo Employee) from such SpinCo Employee. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">14 </P>

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Section<U></U>&nbsp;1.12. <U><FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Non-Solicitation</FONT></U>.
</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a) The Parties acknowledge that RemainCo has invested significant time, costs and resources to select the employees for their proper
roles within their respective workforces. To ensure that each Party receives the benefit of such efforts and retains skilled employees necessary to conduct its business, for a period commencing at the Effective Time and ending twelve
(12)&nbsp;months following the Effective Time, without the prior written consent of the other Party&#8217;s Chief Human Resources Officer (or, if no such position exists, an officer with similar authority), neither Party shall, and each Party shall
cause the members of its Group not to, directly or indirectly, solicit, or otherwise hire for employment or engage to provide services: (1)&nbsp;any employee of any member of the other Party&#8217;s Group (excluding with respect to any RemainCo
Employee or SpinCo Employee, as applicable, who is a Delayed Employment Employee, subject to the terms of <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;1.02(b)</U>); or (2)&nbsp;within six (6)&nbsp;months of the applicable termination of employment, any former
employee of any member of the other Party&#8217;s Group; <U>provided</U>, <U>however</U>, that this <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;1.12(a)</U> shall not apply to an employee who was involuntarily terminated by the other Party. Notwithstanding the
foregoing, the restrictions on solicitation in this <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;1.12(a)</U> shall not apply to hiring for employment or engaging to provide services following response to a solicitation made to the public generally through a bona
fide public advertisement or job posting that is not targeted at employees of the other Party or of any member of the other Party&#8217;s Group. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b) If, at the time of enforcement of this <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;1.12</U>, a court shall hold that the duration, scope or other
restrictions stated herein are unreasonable under circumstances then existing, the Parties agree that the maximum duration, scope or other restrictions reasonable under such circumstances shall be substituted for the stated duration, scope or other
restrictions and that the court shall be allowed to revise the restrictions contained herein to cover the maximum duration, scope and other restrictions then permitted by applicable Law. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Section<U></U>&nbsp;1.13. <U>Employee Records</U>. To the extent required by applicable Law or as reasonably required in order for the Parties
to perform their obligations under this Agreement or as provided in <U>Schedule 1.13</U> to this Agreement, as of no later than the Effective Time, each Party shall have transferred, and shall have caused the applicable member of its Group to
transfer, copies of all applicable employee records, data or information, and compliance-related training documents, with respect to each Impacted Employee to the applicable Party or applicable member of its Group (&#8220;<U>Employee
Records</U>&#8221;) in a manner compliant with applicable Law and <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;9.10</U> of the Separation Agreement and, with respect to medical records (which shall not include &#8220;protected health information&#8221; as
described in the following sentence), in accordance with the treatment of employee medical records provided in <U>Schedule 1.13</U> to this Agreement; <U>provided</U>, <U>however</U>, that no transfers were made to the extent such employee records
were already in the possession and control of the applicable member of its Group. For the avoidance of doubt, Employee Records do not include&nbsp;&#8220;protected health information&#8221; under the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability
Act of 1996, as amended, or any similar state, local or foreign Law. Except as provided in <U>Schedule 1.13</U> to this Agreement, any employee records, data or information not transferred pursuant to this <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;1.13</U>,
including in respect of Former Employees, shall be preserved by the Party in control of such records, data or information for at least as long as required by applicable Law (or, if </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">15 </P>

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">
later, at least as long as such records, data or information is reasonably necessary for the other Party to comply with applicable Law or to administer benefits or fulfill obligations under this
Agreement), and the Party in control of such records, data or information shall provide the other Party access to such records, data and information in accordance with and subject to the terms of <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;1.17</U> hereof and
<U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;9.1</U> and <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;9.2</U> of the Separation Agreement. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Section<U></U>&nbsp;1.14.
<U>HR Liabilities</U>. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a) <I>In General</I>. Except to the extent otherwise required by applicable Law, as otherwise provided in this
Agreement or with respect to Liabilities specifically allocated under <U>Sections 1.05</U> through <U>1.11</U>, <U>Sections 1.14(b)</U>, <U>(c)</U> or <U>(d)</U>&nbsp;or <U>Article II</U>: (i)&nbsp;RemainCo shall, or shall cause a member of the
RemainCo Group to, be Allocated all of the RemainCo HR Liabilities; and (ii)&nbsp;SpinCo shall, or shall cause a member of the SpinCo Group to, be Allocated all of the SpinCo HR Liabilities, in each case, regardless of (A)&nbsp;when or where such
Liabilities arose or arise, (B)&nbsp;whether the facts upon which they are based occurred prior to, on, or subsequent to the Effective Time, (C)&nbsp;where or against whom such Liabilities are asserted or determined, (D)&nbsp;whether arising from or
alleged to arise from negligence, gross negligence, recklessness, violation of Law, fraud or misrepresentation by any member of the RemainCo Group or SpinCo Group, as the case may be, or any of their past or present respective directors, officers,
employees, agents, Subsidiaries or Affiliates and (E)&nbsp;which entity is named in any Action associated with any Liability. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b)
<I>Liabilities for <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Non-Consenting</FONT> Employees</I>. Except to the extent otherwise required by applicable Law or as otherwise provided in this Agreement, including <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;1.06(b)</U>: </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(i) RemainCo shall, or shall cause a member of the RemainCo Group to, be Allocated all of the HR Liabilities related to any <FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Non-Consenting</FONT> Employee who was Ring-Fenced to be a RemainCo Employee, regardless of (A)&nbsp;when or where such Liabilities arose or arise, (B)&nbsp;whether the facts upon which they are based occurred prior to,
on, or subsequent to the Effective Time, (C)&nbsp;where or against whom such Liabilities are asserted or determined, (D)&nbsp;regardless of whether arising from or alleged to arise from negligence, gross negligence, recklessness, violation of Law,
fraud or misrepresentation by any member of the RemainCo Group or SpinCo Group, as the case may be, or any of their past or present respective directors, officers, employees, agents, Subsidiaries or Affiliates and (E)&nbsp;which entity is named in
any Action associated with any Liability; </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(ii) SpinCo shall, or shall cause a member of the SpinCo Group to, be Allocated
all of the HR Liabilities related to any <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Non-Consenting</FONT> Employee who was Ring-Fenced to be a SpinCo Employee, regardless of (A)&nbsp;when or where such Liabilities arose or arise, (B)&nbsp;whether the facts
upon which they are based occurred prior to, on, or subsequent to the Effective Time, (C)&nbsp;where or against whom such Liabilities are asserted or determined, (D)&nbsp;regardless of whether arising from or alleged to arise from negligence, gross
negligence, recklessness, violation of Law, fraud or misrepresentation by any member of the RemainCo Group or SpinCo Group, as the case may be, or any of their past or present respective directors, officers, employees, agents, Subsidiaries or
Affiliates and (E)&nbsp;which entity is named in any Action associated with any Liability. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">16 </P>

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(c) <I>Liabilities for Former Employees</I>. Except to the extent otherwise provided in this
Agreement (including as provided in <U>Schedule 1.14(c)</U> to this Agreement) or the Separation Agreement, as otherwise provided in <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;1.14(b)</U> with respect to Non-Consenting Employees, or as required by applicable
Law, the applicable entity that was the employing legal entity of a Former Employee at the time any HR Liability was incurred with respect to such Former Employee shall be Allocated such HR Liability in respect of such Former Employee;
<U>provided</U> that any HR Liability in respect of any Former Employee or Former Director who was employed or serving in the United States at the time of such person&#8217;s termination of employment or service shall be a RemainCo HR Liability
unless explicitly Allocated to SpinCo pursuant to this Agreement. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(d) <I>Joint and Several Liabilities</I>. With respect to HR
Liabilities that, under applicable Law or Labor Agreement, result in joint and several liability between two or more Parties, such HR Liabilities, to the extent not otherwise addressed herein, shall be apportioned among the Parties based on the
principles of <U>Article VIII</U> (Indemnification) of the Separation Agreement in respect of shared liabilities. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Section<U></U>&nbsp;1.15. <U>Indemnification</U>. Except to the extent otherwise required by applicable Law or as otherwise provided in this
Agreement: </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a) <I>RemainCo Indemnification</I>. RemainCo shall, and shall cause each member of the RemainCo Group to, indemnify, defend
and hold harmless the SpinCo Indemnitees from and against any and all Indemnifiable Losses of the SpinCo Indemnitees to the extent relating to, arising out of, by reason of or otherwise in connection with any failure of RemainCo or any member of the
RemainCo Group to discharge any of their respective obligations (including such obligations of RemainCo that may arise prior to the Effective Time) under this Agreement, including failure to be Allocated any HR Liability in accordance with this
Agreement. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b) <I>SpinCo Indemnification</I>. SpinCo shall, and shall cause each member of the SpinCo Group to, indemnify, defend and
hold harmless the RemainCo Indemnitees from and against any and all Indemnifiable Losses of the RemainCo Indemnitees to the extent relating to, arising out of, by reason of or otherwise in connection with any failure of SpinCo or any member of the
SpinCo Group to discharge any of their respective obligations (including such obligations of SpinCo that may arise prior to the Effective Time) under this Agreement, including failure to be Allocated any HR Liability in accordance with this
Agreement. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(c) The following sections of the Separation Agreement shall apply <I>mutatis mutandis </I>to this Agreement as if such
provisions had been set out expressly in this Agreement: <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;8.4</U> (Procedures for Third-Party Claims), excluding <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;8.4(f)</U> thereof, <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;8.5</U> (Procedures for
Direct Claims), <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;8.6</U> (Cooperation in Defense and Settlement), <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;8.7</U> (Indemnification Payments), <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;8.8</U> (Indemnification Obligations Net of Insurance
Proceeds and Other Amounts) and <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;8.9</U> (Additional Matters; Survival of Indemnities). </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">17 </P>
